summary: Fleet managers can filter vehicles by service status
description:
As a fleet manager I want to filter the vehicle list by service status so that I can see which vehicles need attention.

The filter applies to the vehicle list page only.
acceptance_criteria:
AC1: The vehicle list offers a Service status filter with the options Overdue, Due soon and Up to date.
AC2: Selecting one or more options shows only vehicles in those statuses.
AC3: Clearing the filter restores the complete vehicle list.
